1	/**
     2	 * Workspace Detail View — Repo Parallelizer GUI.
     3	 *
     4	 * Renders the full detail page for a single workspace inside a project:
     5	 *   - Workspace header: ID, description, breadcrumb link back to the project.
     6	 *   - Repository status table: one row per repository, showing current branch,
     7	 *     a color-coded Git status badge, and an error/loading indicator for repos
     8	 *     with no status data yet.
     9	 *   - Live polling: status badges refresh in-place via a 1-second countdown
    10	 *     interval that triggers a poll every 10 seconds. A visible countdown
    11	 *     label and a "Refresh Now" button provide user control. The interval
    12	 *     is cleared via the cleanup function returned from
    13	 *     `renderWorkspaceDetail`, which the router calls before navigating
    14	 *     away.
    15	 *   - Actions: "Switch Branches" navigation button, "Rename Workspace" (disabled
    16	 *     for STABLE), "Delete Workspace" (disabled for STABLE).
    17	 *
    18	 * ## Router integration
    19	 *
    20	 * The view uses the same router-injection pattern as `project-detail.js`:
    21	 * `app.js` calls `setRouter(router)` before `router.start()`. The `_router`
    22	 * variable is null-guarded at every navigation site so the view remains
    23	 * functional in test contexts.
    24	 *
    25	 * ## Cleanup contract
    26	 *
    27	 * `renderWorkspaceDetail` returns a cleanup function. The router's `_render`
    28	 * method already stores and calls any function returned by a view. No changes
    29	 * to `router.js` are needed.
    30	 *
    31	 * @module workspace-detail
    32	 */
    33	
    34	import { api }               from '../api.js';
    35	import { showToast }         from '../components/toast.js';
    36	import { showConfirm }       from '../components/confirm-dialog.js';
    37	import { createStatusBadge } from '../components/status-badge.js';
    38	import { createFormField, validateRequired, WORKSPACE_ID_PATTERN } from '../components/form-helpers.js';
    39	import { normaliseProject, normaliseWorkspace } from '../utils/normalise.js';
    40	
    41	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    42	// Router reference — injected from app.js via setRouter()
    43	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    44	
    45	/** @type {import('../router.js').Router|null} */
    46	let _router = null;
    47	
    48	/**
    49	 * Inject the router instance so workspace-detail can navigate on rename/delete.
    50	 * Called from app.js before the router starts.
    51	 *
    52	 * @param {import('../router.js').Router} router
    53	 */
    54	export function setRouter(router) {
    55	    _router = router;
    56	}
    57	
    58	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    59	// Constants
    60	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    61	
    62	/** Default polling interval in milliseconds (fallback when config fetch fails). */
    63	const DEFAULT_POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 10_000;
    64	
    65	/** The workspace ID that cannot be renamed or deleted. */
    66	const STABLE_WS_ID = 'STABLE';
    67	
    68	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    69	// Normalisation helpers — imported from utils/normalise.js
    70	// extractRepoId and extractRepoName remain local (workspace-detail only).
    71	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    72	
    73	/**
    74	 * Extract a repository's ID from either a plain string or an object.
    75	 * The backend may return Repositories as an array of strings, an array of
    76	 * objects with `Id`/`id`, or an array of objects with `repositoryId`.
    77	 *
    78	 * @param {string|Object} repo
    79	 * @returns {string}
    80	 */
    81	function extractRepoId(repo) {
    82	    if (typeof repo === 'string') return repo;
    83	    return repo.Id || repo.id || repo.RepositoryId || repo.repositoryId || '';
    84	}
    85	
    86	/**
    87	 * Extract a human-readable repository name from a repository entry.
    88	 * Falls back to the ID when no name is available.
    89	 *
    90	 * @param {string|Object} repo
    91	 * @returns {string}
    92	 */
    93	function extractRepoName(repo) {
    94	    if (typeof repo === 'string') return repo;
    95	    return repo.Name || repo.name || extractRepoId(repo);
    96	}
    97	
    98	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    99	// Loading helper
   100	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
